caption: The drawing features two objects on a plain, light beige background. In the upper section, there is a detailed illustration of a metallic object with two large, circular loops joined by a wavy connecting piece and a long, cylindrical handle ending in a flat, circular disc. The metal appears to have a brownish, coppery tone with highlights and shading that suggest a worn or aged surface. Below this, there is a simple outline or sketch of a similar shape, consisting of two circles joined by a curved line, rendered in a light brown monotone. There is no additional décor or context in the background, and the primary focus is on the objects depicted in the center of the page. The artist’s signature, “Elizabeth Johnson,” is visible in small print near the bottom right corner.
title: Branding Iron
